source: Li et al. (2002), Figure 2 main panel, PDF page 3 (printed page 168)
method: Manual selection of isolated curve stripes in losslessly extracted 1350 x 1394 one-bit raster. Figure 2 is PDF image xref 8, not vector linework. Pixel coordinates have origin at top left. Midpoints preserve the initial readings; no adjustment against calculated EOS values.
bound_basis: A deterministic graphical reading bound of approximately 7 vertical pixels. It covers curve half-width up to 5 pixels and about 2 pixels of axis calibration/placement. This is not a measurement error or a statistical confidence interval. Source coefficient rounding is not needed to pass this bound.
